property_summary: The value of MinSum can never be changed after initialization in the reference contract due to reentrancy lock always preventing reentrant calls; the buggy version allows MinSum to be changed during a reentrant call triggered from Collect.

In the reference contract, a reentrant call triggered during Collect cannot change MinSum; the buggy version allows MinSum to be modified via a reentrant call, causing MinSum to differ after Collect completes.

After initialization, the reference contract guarantees MinSum is immutable because SetMinSum is blocked by the nonReentrant_ modifier once the lock is held; the buggy version allows SetMinSum to execute during a reentrant call triggered from Collect, so MinSum can be altered.

In the reference contract, after initialization, MinSum remains constant because SetMinSum cannot be called reentrantly during a Collect-triggered callback; the buggy version allows a reentrant call to change MinSum, causing it to differ after Collect completes.

In the reference contract, after initialization, any reentrant call triggered from Collect cannot change MinSum because nonReentrant_ blocks SetMinSum; the buggy version allows SetMinSum to execute during a reentrant call, so MinSum remains unchanged in reference but can be altered in buggy.
Once initialized, MinSum cannot be changed further.
After the contract is initialized, the value of MinSum is constant.
If the contract has been initialized, calling Collect should not change MinSum.
After initialization, the value of MinSum never changes, regardless of calls to SetMinSum.
After initialization, MinSum must never change. The modified contract allows SetMinSum to change MinSum after initialization.

After initialization, for any Collect call, MinSum before and after the call remains unchanged; the mutated contract allows MinSum to be modified by a SetMinSum call after initialization, which can then affect the behavior of subsequent Collect calls.

After initialization, MinSum can never be increased by a direct SetMinSum call, ensuring it stays as an immutable threshold; the mutated contract allows SetMinSum to raise MinSum after initialization, which can subsequently block Collect from executing.

After initialization, MinSum can never be changed via SetMinSum, so its value persists; the mutant allows SetMinSum to alter MinSum after initialization, breaking the invariant that MinSum remains constant once initialized.

After initialization, for any sequence of calls to Collect, the outcome (success or revert) depends only on the caller's balance and unlock time and not on MinSum having been changed by a later SetMinSum call; the bug allows MinSum to be changed after initialization, altering Collect's behavior for the same caller state.
Once Initialized has been called, all subsequent nonReentrant_ functions must revert on reentrant calls; violating the modifier allows Put to succeed during a reentrant Collect callback.
